adaptation.anykernel.sh: RMX3997/MT6835 Android16, active boot size/header/Image checks; WK split_boot + flash_boot; retain split ramdisk, no ramdisk reconstruction or multi-partition dispatch; AVB original-input validation before flash_boot; kernel version comparison explicitly after split/header validation
adaptation.tools/ak3-core.sh: Pinned core with optional key-event scratch relocated to AKHOME and split magiskboot unpack -n -h: retain original compressed ramdisk/DT components byte-for-byte instead of decompressing/recompressing them. Repack and flash methods unchanged. Payload dd adds conv=fsync: actual persistent ENOSPC guest showed plain buffered dd could return success before kernel writeback failure. No automatic rollback or new transaction. AVB correction hook immediately before partition write; rmx-avb.sh verifies original NONE/SHA256_RSA2048 metadata under explicit RMX3997 0/unlocked/orange policy and regenerates descriptor from the complete dynamically sized repacked payload using pinned avbroot 3.37.1 documented pack --force without a key for truthful CUSTOM-UNSIGNED NONE output; no parent vbmeta or rollback flag changes. Version safety check uses the captured split kernel payload and is invoked by anykernel.sh after split_boot; it never scans/decompresses an Android boot container.
adaptation.META-INF/com/google/android/update-binar: Pinned backend with required on-disk AKHOME, booted-Android-only gate and disk debug paths; recovery helpers remain unreachable
adaptation.install-on-device.sh: Android mksh launcher extracts to private disk path, verifies SHA256SUMS and invokes real WK backend; no custom boot-image transaction
